TRAMO Model

Source: R/models.R
TRAMO.Rd

Defines a TRAMO model (the pre-adjustment model used in TRAMO-SEATS), without seasonal adjustment, to be used inside fabletools::model(). The model is estimated with rjd3tramoseats::jtramo() and the Java result is kept in the fitted model. Arguments and specials are the same as for TRAMOSEATS(), except x11(), seats() and benchmarking(), which do not apply and are ignored with a warning.

Usage

TRAMO(
  formula,
  spec = c("trfull", "tr0", "tr1", "tr2", "tr3", "tr4", "tr5"),
  context = NULL,
  ref_spec = spec,
  ...
)

Arguments

formula

Model formula: the name of the variable to adjust (y), or y ~ specials (see jd3_specials).

spec

Base specification: a character name (see rjd3tramoseats::tramo_spec() for the available names; the default is the first one) or a specification object from rjd3tramoseats::tramo_spec().

context

A modelling context created with rjd3toolkit::modelling_context() (e.g. for custom calendars), or NULL.

ref_spec

Reference specification stored in the model: it is the reference of the refresh policies used by refit() and stream(). Defaults to spec, that is the specification before its modification by the specials.

...

Currently unused.

Value

A model definition that can be passed to fabletools::model(). Once fitted, the mable column contains a jd3_model object.

Details

There is no decomposition, so components() is not available. The other methods are: fitted(), residuals(), forecast(), backcast(), outliers(), tidy(), glance() and report().

See also

TRAMOSEATS(), REGARIMA(), jd3_specials, jd3_model_methods

Examples

y <- tsibble::as_tsibble(AirPassengers)
mb <- model(y, tramo = TRAMO(value))
tidy(mb)
#> # A tibble: 6 × 6
#>   .model term         estimate std.error statistic  p.value
#>   <chr>  <chr>           <dbl>     <dbl>     <dbl>    <dbl>
#> 1 tramo  btheta(1)    -0.498    0.0710       -7.01 1.34e-10
#> 2 tramo  td2          -0.00298  0.000475     -6.28 5.28e- 9
#> 3 tramo  Leap year     0.0409   0.0116        3.52 5.96e- 4
#> 4 tramo  easter [6]    0.0198   0.00692       2.87 4.85e- 3
#> 5 tramo  AO (1951-05)  0.101    0.0189        5.36 3.97e- 7
#> 6 tramo  AO (1954-02) -0.0698   0.0186       -3.74 2.76e- 4
report(mb)
#> Series: value 
#> Model: TRAMO, ARIMA(0,1,0)(0,1,1) 
#> Transformation: Log; N obs.: 144 
#> 
#> 
#> Coefficients
#>                Estimate Std. Error t value Pr(>|t|)    
#> btheta(1)    -0.4981058  0.0710399  -7.012 1.34e-10 ***
#> td2          -0.0029813  0.0004749  -6.278 5.28e-09 ***
#> Leap year     0.0408796  0.0116009   3.524 0.000596 ***
#> easter [6]    0.0198358  0.0069154   2.868 0.004851 ** 
#> AO (1951-05)  0.1014823  0.0189455   5.357 3.97e-07 ***
#> AO (1954-02) -0.0697738  0.0186375  -3.744 0.000276 ***
#> ---
#> Signif. codes:  0 ‘***’ 0.001 ‘**’ 0.01 ‘*’ 0.05 ‘.’ 0.1 ‘ ’ 1
#> 
#> Tests on residuals: Independence (Ljung-Box: Good, 0.128); Normality (Doornik-Hansen: Good, 0.659)

# Forecasts of the raw series
forecast(mb, h = 12)
